cli.help.page.wizard:
Tepozmecayotl tlen techtlajtlani pack

Tlaneltokiliztli:
  greentic-pack wizard
  greentic-pack wizard run [OPTIONS]
  greentic-pack wizard validate --answers <FILE> [OPTIONS]
  greentic-pack wizard apply --answers <FILE> [OPTIONS]

Tlayekketl tlen moneki miakpa:
  --locale <LOCALE>        quitlalia in tlajtolli CLI/wizard (kehnin: en, en-GB, nl)

Tlayekketl para run:
  --answers <FILE>         quimohuica AnswerDocument huan quichihua apply yancuic amo mononotza
  --emit-answers <FILE>    quihcuiloa AnswerDocument satepan run
  --schema                 quipannextia in axan schema tlen AnswerDocument huan quisa
  --schema-version <VER>   quitlalia in schema version para emit/migration
  --migrate                quicahuilia auto-migration intla schema metadata amo onca/achtoh
  --dry-run                quicuiloa tlen mocpehpeni huan quipannextia answers ahmo ica side effects

`wizard` (ahmo ica subcommand) quichihua in interactive main menu.
